title: Teach the Rover
subtitle: Train your first AI model
description: Train the camera model to tell roads, debris, flood water, supply crates and people apart, then drive to the command centre.
story: The rover now has a camera, but a camera on its own understands nothing. Before it can help anyone, somebody has to teach it what it is looking at. That somebody is your team.
learningObjectives: Training data is a set of examples with labels attached
A model learns patterns from features, not from magic
Confidence tells you how sure the model is, not how right it is
If one label has far fewer examples, the model will be bad at that label

objectives.description: Get at least 70% of camera predictions right during the run
Drive to the command centre in the south-east
Bonus: enter no more than one hazard tile

failureConditions.message: The battery ran flat before reaching the command centre.
Time ran out before the rover reached the command centre.
The rover crashed too many times and was recalled for repairs.

hints: Open the AI Lab first. You cannot run this mission without a trained model and an AI Camera fitted.
Your starter dataset is deliberately unbalanced. Count the examples per label before you train.
Hazard Zone and Person or Target both contain warm colours, so the model mixes them up. Add more examples of both.
Short of time? Instant Training Mode gives you a working model straight away, but you will learn less.
reflectionQuestions: Which two labels did your model confuse most often? Why do you think that happened?
What changed when you added more examples of the rarest label?
Is a model with 90% accuracy safe enough to drive a real rescue rover? Explain your answer.
